title: Q&A Exchange Transcript (live-tutor)
description: Boundary schema for a captured live Q&A exchange and its turns, owned by exactly one learner and anchored to a lesson + relevant source item. Mirrors packages/contracts/src/qa.ts (Zod source of truth).

text.description: Transcript of one utterance. Private learner content.

turnIndex.description: 0-based order of this turn within its exchange.

sourceItemId.description: Relevant item active at interruption; null if none resolvable (e.g. before first item).

exchangeIndex.description: 0-based order of this exchange within the lesson.

interruptionPositionSeconds.description: Exact lesson playback position to resume from after the exchange.

CreateExchangeRequest.description: Payload to persist a completed exchange (POST .../exchanges). exchangeIndex is assigned server-side if omitted.

LiveSessionToken.description: Owner-scoped credential the browser uses to open a realtime agent session. The xi-api-key NEVER appears here.

conversationToken.description: Short-lived ElevenLabs conversation token minted server-side.

dynamicVariables.description: Per-session grounding context injected into the agent prompt (lesson summary, items, current item).
